contracts.purpose: Short-lived cross-platform access grant for active trial or subscription membership.

verification.cacheRule: Cache only public JWKS according to its HTTP response headers; fail closed if it cannot be loaded or parsed.

clientRules: Require the client platform ID as JWT audience.
Require an unexpired grant and an eligible membership state.
Create only a short-lived, HttpOnly, Secure local session after validation.
Consume the grant once and redirect to a clean local URL.
Return an error response with no-store when the grant is missing or invalid.
Never log, store, display, or place a grant in analytics, support tickets, or browser history intentionally.

requiredBeforeCrossPlatformRouting: Registry contract version is supported by both source and target.
Target completion endpoint returns a protected non-cacheable error without a grant.
Target validates issuer, audience, signature, expiry, and eligible membership.
Target creates an HttpOnly Secure local session only after validation.
A signed-in owner test reaches the target clean URL without exposing the grant.
No unrelated feature, payment, user-content, or secret change is included in the release.
releaseGate.rollbackRule: Disable the affected target in the authority registry and return to its clean homepage fallback if any validation fails.

changeManagement.compatibilityRule: Increment the contract version for any claim, validation, session, or endpoint behavior change.
changeManagement.reviewRule: Review the registry and target contract tests before publishing any cross-platform routing change.
changeManagement.supportRule: Support tooling may record platform ID and technical error category only; it must not copy grants, cookies, secrets, or user content.
